title: OPAL data collection software
description:
Software used to collect and prepare OPAL, a multimodal ambient sensor dataset for activity, occupancy and energy analysis in an office workspace, described in the accompanying Data Descriptor.

The repository consolidates three tools that were previously maintained separately:

  • data-collection — polls Shelly smart plugs over the local network at 1 s and SmartThings devices (plugs, motion sensors, door-contact sensors, a stick vacuum and camera event channels) through the SmartThings API at 60 s, with a live dashboard and a supervisor that restarts a stalled collector.
  • har-datalogger — the application the three primary participants used to record activity transitions in real time, and to produce the raw, refined and merged self-report logs behind the activity annotations.
  • homecam-media-converter — converts CN Core HomeCam .media files to MP4 (H.264 + AAC) for annotation review; the converted video is not part of the public dataset.

No credential, token, private network address, collected measurement or participant identifier is present in this repository. Device addresses and acquisition paths are supplied at run time through a configuration file that is excluded from version control.

This software is not required to use the released dataset, which is self-describing; it is published so that the acquisition can be audited and reproduced.
